tools.name: list_packaging_models
tools.description: Browse the packaging you can design on Creadal: boxes, pouches, bottle and jar labels, cans, cups, bags, sacks, pillow packs, mugs, t-shirts, tote bags, keychains and sneakers. Each model comes with its sizes, a photo-real preview picture and its page. Use it to pick the model for create_packaging_d

tools.name: generate_dieline
tools.description: Give the size of a box, label, pouch, sack or pillow pack in millimetres and get its print-ready dieline (cut and fold lines, bleed) as PDF and SVG links, ready for the printer or any design software. Same engine as the free dieline generator on creadal.com. Free, no account needed. Sizes: box = len

tools.name: create_packaging_design
tools.description: Tell it the product and the packaging, and get a finished packaging design in the member's Creadal account: a professionally laid-out ready design for that model with the brand, product name and label facts filled in, a preview picture, the 3D look, a print PDF link and a link to open it in the Crea

tools.name: list_my_designs
tools.description: The member's latest Creadal designs in the connected workspace, newest first, each with a link to open it in the editor.

tools.name: get_design
tools.description: One of the member's designs: its title, a preview picture and links to open it in the editor and to download its print PDF.

tools.name: export_print_pdf
tools.description: A download link for a design's print-ready PDF (and a PNG), valid for 24 hours, to send to a printer or keep.

tools.name: get_quota
tools.description: The member's Creadal plan and what is left of it this period (AI images, AI video seconds), with a link to upgrade.

tools.name: create_social_design
tools.description: Make a social media post or ad in the member's Creadal account from a professionally designed ready template: headline, supporting line, offer, call-to-action button, brand and website filled in, the member's own picture (a product photo or an app or website screenshot, given as a public https link)

tools.name: generate_presentation
tools.description: Generate a complete, editable presentation or document from a prompt (for a social post, story or ad use create_social_design instead: it starts from a designed template and places the member's own picture and logo). Waits for the result when generation is quick; otherwise returns a job to poll with

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Poll a generation or export job by id. A completed generation job's result carries designId and editorUrl.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List the templates visible to this key's workspace (built-ins and workspace templates). Pass an id as generate_presentation's templateId to compose on that template's layout system and theme.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List the built-in theme catalog (id, name, style group, six palette slots, font pair). Pass an id as generate_presentation's themeId.

tools.name: get_design_file
tools.description: Fetch a design's open-format file (creadal.desing JSON): pages, nodes, theme, speaker notes. Large files are summarized instead of inlined. Requires the 'read' scope.

tools.name: export_design
tools.description: Get download URLs for a design's server-side exports (PDF and PNG). Fetch them with the same Authorization bearer key. Requires the 'export' scope.

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: Create a share link for a design (view/comment/edit, optional password, expiry, and audience label for per-link analytics). Returns the share URL and the ?embed=1 iframe URL. Requires the 'export' scope.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_social_design, export_design, create_share_link · Private data: generate_presentation, get_design_file, create_share_link · Public sink: export_print_pdf, create_social_design, generate_presentation, create_share_link · Destructive: get_design_file.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_social_design, export_design, create_share_link · Private data: generate_presentation, get_design_file, create_share_link · Public sink: export_print_pdf, create_social_design, generate_presentation, create_share_link · Destructive: get_design_file

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
